value.text: The foreign transcript evaluation submitted is a general report. A detailed course-by-course evaluation from a Commission-approved agency is required.
The evaluation does not verify completion of a professional preparation program in elementary education including student teaching.

facts.original_text: 1. The foreign transcript evaluation submitted is a general report ... 2. The evaluation does not verify completion ...
You have 60 days from the date of this letter to submit the requested materials.
Materials must be accompanied by a copy of this letter.
